full_judgment: 3. Mr. B. K. Das, learned Advocate for the plaintiff-petitioners submits that the High Court Division misread the judgment of the lower appellate Court that it gave a finding that the lower appellate Court found that the presumption of R. S. record under section 103B of the Bengal Tenancy Act been rebutted by subsequent entry in the M. R. R. Khatian standing in the name of the defendants. He submits that there is no such finding of the lower appellate Court.
